sloka: ते प्रीताः पादपाग्रेषु गृह्य शाखाः सुविष्ठिताः ।वासांसीव प्रशाखाश्च समाविध्यन्त वानराः ।। 5.57.27 ।।।।
transliteration: te prītāḥ pādapāgreṣu gṛhya śākhāḥ suviṣṭhitāḥ ।vāsāṁsīva praśākhāśca samāvidhyanta vānarāḥ ।। 5.57.27 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the powerful son of the Windgod roared like the wind captured in a mountain cave would.
